title: Move src/ off vendored stringcase v1 onto v2
prompt: The vendored stringcase lib got v2 (vendor/stringcase-v2) and src/ must move onto it: point src's imports at the v2 module and port the call sites. v2's README lists the breaking changes — read it before porting. The contract is current behavior: every output of src/normalize.mjs stays exactly as it is today on the inputs it serves (acronym-heavy and camel-humped words included), so where a v2 change would alter an output, keep the old output by adapting the call site instead. Do not edit anything under vendor/.
